description.text: The major of international economy and trade trains senior applied talents who systematically master international economy and trade theory, have strong international economic and trade business operation ability, good business communication ability, good scientific research and innovation ability to think independently and solve problems, and engage in economic and trade business, international business and economic research

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Chang'an University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Valid ordinary passport. If the applicant is in China, a valid residence permit also needs to be submitted.2. Highest academic degree certificate (Fresh graduates should provide a pre-graduation certificate and bring a paper graduation certificate when reporting to China in September);3. Academic transcript4. "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners"Applicants should strictly follow the items required in the "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners" for the examination and fill it out in either Chinese or English. The "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners" is invalid if it is missing pages, does not have the individual's photo attached, does not have a cross-stamp on the photo, or does not have the hospital's seal or the doctor's signature. Given that the validity period of the inspection results is six months. Applicants are requested to determine the time for their physical examination accordingly.5. A valid certificate of no criminal record. If the applicant is already in China, only a performance certificate or a certificate of no disciplinary violations issued by the current institution is required.6. Proof of language proficiency;7. Study plan (undergraduate) or research plan (master's and doctoral);8. Two recommendation letters signed by (associate) professors (undergraduate students exempted);9. Acceptance letter from the supervisor (not mandatory, but the submitter will be given priority for admission);10. Can be submitted: academic achievements [very important], certificates of awards from various cultural and sports activities.

requirements.text: 1.Between 18 and 25 years old, in good health.2. Complete high school or equivalent courses, with all subjects on the transcript required to be passed or above. Students who have not obtained a high school diploma must submit a pre-graduation certificate.3. Chinese proficiency requirements for Chinese-taught majors:All majors in the School of Humanities require a score of 180 or above in HSK Level 4 or a one-year study of Chinese at our school and passing the exam.4. Professional English proficiency requirements for English-taught programs:Toefl 80 or above; Ielts 6.0 or above; Duolingo score 100 or above; Or equivalent English proficiency certificates, such as EF.5. If the previous learning stage was taught in Chinese or English, proof of the corresponding language of instruction can be submitted, and the language proficiency certificate is exempted.
